title: MCQ: What is the result of `check(new int[]{5, 20}, 5)`?
prompt:
What is the result of `check(new int[]{5, 20}, 5)`?

```java
public static boolean check(int[] arr, int idx) {
    return idx < arr.length && arr[idx] > 10;
}
```

A. true
B. ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
C. false
D. compile error

Print your answer as: the option letter, then your explanation of why it is correct and why each other option is wrong. First line must start with the letter.

tests.name: C C
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("C"), "the chosen option's explanation (starts with the letter)");
tests.hint: C. `&&` short-circuits: `5 < 2` is false, so `arr[5]` is never evaluated — no exception, just false. B is the classic short-circuit blindness; A misreads the comparison; D is wrong because the guard is exactly the safe pattern.
